name: CRM - Sales Pipeline Dashboard
description: Metabase dashboard configuration for CRM sales pipeline visualization

native.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(value) as total_value FROM crm_opportunities WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY status ORDER BY total_value DESC

SELECT full_name, company, email, source, created_at FROM crm_leads WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT source, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='WON' THEN 1 END)*100.0/COUNT(*) as conversion_rate FROM crm_leads l LEFT JOIN crm_opportunities o ON l.id = o.lead_id WHERE l.tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} GROUP BY source

SELECT date_trunc('month', expected_close_date) as month, SUM(value * probability/100) as forecast FROM crm_opportunities WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status NOT IN ('WON','LOST') AND expected_close_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
